blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `debitAccountStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step debits one or more store credit accounts by creating debit transactions.
The step supports rollback by deleting the created transactions.

children.name: account_id
children.description: The ID of the store credit account to debit.

children.name: amount
children.description: The amount to debit.

children.name: note
children.description: An optional note describing the debit.

children.name: reference
children.description: The resource type this debit references (for example, "cart", "order").

children.name: reference_id
children.description: The ID of the referenced resource.

children.name: id
